title: Warehouse
description: A warehouse holding stock up to a capacity. Order stock from the supplier (charged to the company budget) or transfer stock to another warehouse (a cross-Thing effect, no cost).

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Maximum units this warehouse can hold.

orderCounter.title: Order Counter
orderCounter.description: Number of orders placed; backs deterministic order ids.

orderStock.title: Order Stock
orderStock.description: Order units from the supplier; cost is the supplier's unit price times the quantity, charged to the company budget.
orderStock.vre:effects: const company = <company-budget>; const supplier = <supplier>; const system = <warehouse-system>; currentStock' = currentStock + quantity; orderCounter' = orderCounter + 1; company.monthlySpent' = company.monthlySpent + quantity * supplier.unitPrice; system.totalCurrentStock' = system.totalCurrentStock + quantity; output.success = true; output.cost = quantity * supplier.unitPrice; output.newStock = currentStock'; output.orderId = "ORD-" + this.id + "-" + orderCounter'; output.message = "Ordered " + quantity + " units";

transferStock.title: Transfer Stock
transferStock.description: Move units from this warehouse to another warehouse.
transferStock.vre:effects: currentStock' = currentStock - quantity; toWarehouse.currentStock' = toWarehouse.currentStock + quantity; output.success = true; output.quantity = quantity; output.from.currentStock = currentStock'; output.to.currentStock = toWarehouse.currentStock';
